name: Agile
text: Enemies start at the top of the Timeline.

name: Blinking
text: Your creatures' spells deal 90% less damage.

name: Brutal
text: Enemies deal 100% more damage and always deal critical damage.

name: Champion
text: Leader is immune to damage, debuffs, and stat reduction while allies are alive.

name: Feedback
text: After your creatures cast a spell, they take damage equal to 20% of Maximum Health

name: Hearty
text: Enemies have 100% more Health and take 50% less damage.

name: Hex
text: Your creatures' spells consume 3 additional Charges.

name: Misery
text: Your creatures cannot gain buffs or stats.

name: Obtuse
text: Your creatures' attacks deal 90% less damage.

name: Plague
text: Your creatures are afflicted with a random debuff at the start of their turns.

name: Protected
text: Enemies cannot take damage that exceeds more than 25% of their Maximum Health.

name: Thorns
text: 50% of damage taken by enemies is reflected, up to 100% of the enemies' Current Health.

name: Undying
text: Enemies resurrect after a short period of time.

name: Vengeance
text: After an enemy dies, all other enemies gain 30% stats.
